people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Hammedatha
people.line: The father of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.

translations.web: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.
translations.bsb: They killed these ten sons of Haman son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.
translations.kjv: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
translations.asv: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jew's enemy, slew they; but on the spoil they laid not their hand.
